verdict.rationale: Instinct is an AI personal assistant, so running code on a user's data to produce charts, computed answers, and downloadable files is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions code execution, chart generation, or file output. Access to Google Sheets/Drive and a tester's vague mention of 'working on our data room' describe data access, not the assistant writing and running code.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant write and run code on my data to produce charts, computed answers, and downloadable files
